prompt: Complete LengthGrouper.byLength so it groups words into a Map from word length to the list of words with that length, keeping each list in encounter order.
explanation: Collectors.groupingBy(classifier) is the stream way to bucket elements: the classifier (here String::length, a method reference) computes each element's key, and all elements sharing a key are collected into a List in encounter order. The one-argument form defaults to collecting each group with toList, so the whole method is a single collect call. The resulting map has an entry only for lengths that actually occur; anything else comes back null from get.
hints: The classifier function maps a word to its grouping key -- its length, i.e. String::length.
The single-argument groupingBy already collects each group into a List, so no second collector is needed.
